chunks: 3358 - And ʿAmr ibn Jumayʿ narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh, from his father, peace be upon them both, who said:
"Have someone bear witness to your testimony who is sincere toward you."
They said: "May Allah keep you well, how can it increase or decrease?" He said: "No, rather one who preserves it for you."
And testimony upon a testimony upon a testimony is not permissible.

key_terms.شَهَادَتِكَ: your testimony in a legal or evidentiary context
key_terms.يَنْصَحُكَ: is sincere and trustworthy toward you

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about testimony based on another testimony?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses legal procedure in giving testimony, instructing that one should entrust testimony to someone who will preserve it accurately. It also establishes a ruling that layered testimony built upon another testimony is not valid.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.3358 - Amr ibn Jumay' narrated from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as):
Imam (as) said: "Let someone trustworthy bear witness to your testimony."
They asked: 'May Allah (swt) keep you well, how can it increase or decrease?'
Imam (as) replied: "No, but it should be someone who preserves it for you."
Imam (as) also said: "It is not permissible to testify upon a testimony that is based on another testimony."
